name: createVideo
label: Create Video
description: Start an asynchronous Taodock video generation task and return its task ID. Poll with Get Video Status, then use Download Video once completed.

parameters.name: model
parameters.label: Model
parameters.help: Video model ID, e.g. agnes-video-2.5. Run List Models to discover IDs.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.label: Duration (seconds)
parameters.help: Optional video length in seconds. 0 uses the model default.

parameters.name: negativePrompt
parameters.label: Negative Prompt
parameters.help: Optional: what to avoid in the video.

samples.prompt: A timelapse of clouds moving over a mountain ridge
